caveats: Intervals include diagnostic emission overhead; this is not ordinary Full performance or model/SLO qualification.
Utility-send to native-begin includes transport, serialization and scheduling; it is not isolated queue or network time.
Native wall interval includes physical inventory and its instrumentation; synchronous native thread CPU is separate, not async request CPU.
Concurrent replica queries overlap. Do not sum attempts as request latency; RPC IDs are not request IDs.
Only complete successful chains enter interval summaries. Missing/cancelled/error/partial evidence is retained, not imputed zero.
Business classification uses parent begin versus arrival start; it includes drain and does not identify a request critical path.
Within-attempt adjacent means are additive for the same population; their quantiles and overlapping parent totals are not additive.

preliminary.qualification_caveat: Native token checks do not establish numerical adapter correctness or formal SLO; request failures remain in the planned denominator. No formal ranking.
preliminary.metadata_transform: ASCII line indentation only; all values and line boundaries retained

caveats: Occurrences are not CPU-time percentages or wall-time phases.
Main-thread counters exclude the observer; idle frames remain included.
Inclusive frame counts overlap; per-process denominators differ.
GIL delay can hide busy intervals; C/CUDA internal frames absent.
Process CPU includes native threads; observer CPU excludes final sample.
Final partial lines and missing roles are explicit, not zero overhead.
Request window includes drain; absent full terminal population has no inferred end.
